description: Keep a changelog a consumer can act on: what changed, what breaks and what to do about it. Use when releasing, when a skill version changes, or when readers cannot tell whether an update affects them.

tools.description: Lints changelog entries for actionability and breaking-change disclosure.

entries.text: skills are folders with a manifest instead of loose markdown files
entries.action: run workflow validate --strict and add skill.json to local skills

entries.text: workflow run executes a routed plan and writes a hash-chained journal

acceptance.statement: the skill's exit criteria are met
